title: In arm_lpae_split_blk_unmap of io-pgtable-arm-common.c, there is a possible memory corruption due to… (CVE-2026-59043)
description: A race condition in the arm_lpae_split_blk_unmap function of io-pgtable-arm-common.c can cause memory corruption. This vulnerability allows local privilege escalation without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction.
